notes.title: Updates #2
notes.content:
- Added 3 new cards, "Gain Antidote", "Leaf Shield" and (locked)
- Replaced "Heavy Shield" with "Stealthy Shield" 
- Replaced "Remove Effects" potion with "Dispel Potion" 
- Added new effect "Antidote" which reduces negative effects on the player.
- Fixed "Stoker" crash bug
- Minor art updates
- Minor bug fixes
- Updates to save system
